newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TNT Express Worldwide considers surcharge.
newsitem.headline: TNT Express Worldwide considers surcharge.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide said it may have to consider some form of fuel surcharge in the future.
James Wilson, senior vice-president Europe, said the company is under increasing pressure and is considering the introduction of a fuel surcharge.
"The cost of fuel in the world markets has been suffering ongoing increases. TNT has been trying to protect its customers from any additional surcharges," he said.

Wilson added: "It is easier to avoid extra costs within our fully owned network but we are subject to the increases when we use commercial flights." - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
